features.name: Update AL-Go system files on multiple branches
features.description: Ability to run update AL-Go system files on multiple branches simultaneously, with optional scheduling. Allows setting branches to include and automatically updates AL-Go system files on all active branches to a specified template URL.
caveats: Recommended to run on a schedule

features.name: NuGet feed select mode
features.description: New setting to control NuGet package selection strategy with options: earliest matching, earliest exact, latest, or latest matching. Earliest matching considers dependency compatibility with the Business Central version being targeted.
caveats: Previously hardcoded to latest matching

features.name: BC container settings from variables
features.description: BC container helper settings can now be read from settings variables (org settings and repo settings), including global settings like memory limits, in addition to repository settings files.

features.name: Publish apps from pull requests
features.description: Ability to publish artifacts from a pull request to an environment for manual testing and code review before approving. Uses PR_[number] syntax in publish to environment workflow, with default artifact retention of one day.
caveats: Artifacts expire after one day
Must rerun build if deploying after artifact expiration

features.name: GitHub Packages for internal dependencies
features.description: Recommended dependency resolution mechanism for internal dependencies using NuGet packages on GitHub, set up by creating GitHub packages context secret. Automatically enables internal dependency resolution.
caveats: Separate setup needed for external third-party dependencies
Not recommended to use exact versions

features.name: Incremental builds
features.description: Only builds and deploys apps that were actually modified in a push, skipping unchanged apps and using last known good builds from previous deployments. When you have an incremental build, it will copy artifacts from the last known good build.
features.status_evidence_quote: so I'm expecting that uh this is the feature that we we just released in version 6.4 which is incremental builds.
caveats: Full rebuild triggered by any settings file change
Settings variable changes do not trigger full rebuild

features.name: Runtime packages for AppSource apps
features.description: Partners can publish AppSource apps as runtime packages and share them to other partners instead of auto-generated symbols, requiring online environments for publishing.
caveats: Missing a few features for full implementation
Dependent on partner adoption

features.name: AL-Go workshop for migration
features.description: Learning resource at aka.ms/algo workshop that guides users through switching from Azure DevOps to AL-Go for GitHub with documentation on different workflows and settings.
caveats: Requires learning curve
Migration approach is discard old pipelines and use AL-Go workflows

features.name: AL-Go settings reference
features.description: Complete reference documentation at aka.ms/go settings covering all available AL-Go configuration settings and their mechanisms.

features.name: GitHub NuGet package resolution
features.description: Method to obtain partner apps individually via GitHub NuGet, addressing issues with dependency resolution for indirect dependencies that cause searches to abort.
caveats: Indirect dependency resolution issues
Performance problems with long search times

features.name: Auto-uninstall old app versions
features.description: Automatically unpublish old app versions when deploying, preventing multiple versions of the same app from being published to the environment.
features.status_evidence_quote: the ability to uninstall or unpublish actually an an old app um was not available. That is available now
caveats: Recently added to Business Central
Still needs implementation in AL-Go

features.name: Multiple organizational variables
features.description: Support for multiple organizational variables to have different settings for internal and PTE apps, potentially using conditional settings.
caveats: Not currently possible
Requires understanding exact customer scenarios

features.name: Azure Boards GitHub integration
features.description: Native GitHub integration with Azure Boards allowing linking pull requests and GitHub issues to Azure DevOps work items using hashtags and work item IDs.
caveats: Less integrated than 100% Azure DevOps workflow
Requires GitHub app installation

features.name: Smart rebuild on settings changes
features.description: Planned improvement to trigger full rebuild only on configuration changes that impact apps, rather than all settings file changes, to improve incremental build efficiency.
caveats: Current behavior is aggressive and triggers full rebuilds
Uncertain if impact detection is possible

features.name: Scheduled incremental builds
features.description: You can set up builds on a schedule and specify that incremental builds will run on a schedule as well. However, if you trigger builds with a workflow run on the CI/CD workflow, it will not do an incremental build.
caveats: Manual workflow runs trigger full builds instead
Incremental builds only apply to scheduled builds

features.name: Treat warnings as errors setting
features.description: You can specify to fail on warnings, and there is a setting called treat warnings as errors which is a container helper setting. It accepts an array of AL warning codes that should be treated as errors.
caveats: Is a container helper setting
Requires specifying AL warning codes as an array

features.name: Fail on warnings workflow setting
features.description: You can set fail on to warning which will fail your workflow if you have any warnings in the code.

features.name: Scheduled deployment to environment
features.description: You can create a workflow that triggers a publish to an environment at a specific time using cron tab scheduling. A partner used this to deploy to the latest released version to the customer every Friday evening at 8:00.
caveats: Requires manual YAML file setup
Not a built-in feature

features.name: Build modes for version testing
features.description: Each CI/CD build can be built in three different modes: one default, one for next major, and one for next minor. Your CI/CD will run all three builds and will only succeed if all three builds succeed.
caveats: Not automatically chained to prod deployment
Requires manual configuration

features.name: Trusted signing with Azure
features.description: A built-in mechanism in AL-Go for GitHub that automates the process of signing applications using Azure trusted signing, as an alternative to PFX files which are no longer obtainable.
caveats: Requires setup of Azure trusted signing
Legacy PFX file mechanism still works if secrets are configured correctly

features.name: Code signing via Azure Key Vault and net sign
features.description: A mechanism to sign applications using Azure Key Vault to host certificates and net sign to perform the signing, built into AL-Go for GitHub.
caveats: Requires Azure Key Vault setup
Alternative to legacy PFX mechanism

features.name: Create release action
features.description: An action used to create releases in the CI/CD workflow that previously worked out of the box but now requires running the CI/CD workflow additional times before functioning properly.
caveats: Recent behavior change requires running CI/CD workflow multiple times
Issue not yet investigated or confirmed

features.name: GitHub discussions for community Q&A
features.description: A proposed feature to use GitHub discussions as an alternative channel for announcements and Q&A instead of requiring users to wait for monthly office hours.
caveats: Not yet actively implemented
Requires removal of issue templates to point users to discussions instead

features.name: GitHub discussions as alternative to issues
features.description: Proposal to remove question template from issues and point users to discussions instead for better community engagement and faster response times.
caveats: Requires more active monitoring of discussions by maintainers
